svg.title: Black over Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Museum-classified painting in painted aluminum. Projecting black form is simplified to its observed frontal silhouette; material depth and shadow omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/99.338/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
